titulo: Vitachy Soap Dish Kitchen Dispenser Dishwasher – Scrubber and Cloth
bullets: MULTIFUNCTIONAL: 350 ml pressure washer soap dispenser, 350 ml hand soap dispenser, storage space for the sponge, and drying holder for the cloth.
RESISTANT: Resists all kinds of chemical agents without altering its aesthetic and functional characteristics. It won't turn white or stain that can't be washed.
DIMENSIONS: Measures 17 x 10 x 17.5 cm, ideal size for any sink or kitchen counter.
EASILY CLEAN: The product is easily assembled and disassembled with your hands. It can be cleaned completely quickly.
PRESENTATION: It is served in a box and protected with a plastic.
descripcion_html: Sink cleaning set that combines a pressure washer soap dispenser, hand soap dispenser, and organizer to place the cloth and scrubber all in one. The product is made with the union of several types of technical plastics and a stainless steel support that give it great strength and durability. The surface does not fade and is not easy to scratch. Withstands all kinds of chemical agents. Dishwasher tank: 350 ml Tank for hand soap: 350 ml Product weight: 305 grs Dimensions: 17 x 10 x 17.5 cm
